name: bamboohr
description: Read and write employee records, paid time off, onboarding, custom fields, and HR reports through the official BambooHR MCP server — a thin wrapper over the BambooHR Open API at api.bamboohr.com.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the BambooHR Open API through the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The BambooHR skill exposes the official bamboohr/mcp-server as a single Fractal toolset. It connects to the BambooHR Open API at `https://api.bamboohr.com/api/gateway.php/{subdomain}/v1` using HTTP Basic Authentication (API key as the username) and surfaces every employee, time-off, onboarding, and reporting operation as an MCP tool. The skill ships with three families of tools: core employee lookups and updates (search, get, directory, custom fields), time-off operations (PTO balances, request lifecycle, who-is-out, holidays), and reporting + HR ops (custom reports, headcount, turnover, new hires, terminations, user-defined tables). Authentication is configured through the `BAMBOOHR_API_KEY` and `BAMBOOHR_SUBDOMAIN` environment variables. Read-only by default — every write tool requires explicit user confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Use the BambooHR skill whenever the task involves looking up an employee, listing the company directory, checking PTO balances, or running an HR report.
Resolve names and emails to a BambooHR `employeeId` with `bamboohr_search_employees` before calling any `bamboohr_get_*` tool — those tools require the numeric id.
Always confirm with the user before calling any tool that writes or mutates HR records (updates, time-off approvals, custom field changes).
